lines.t: When I think about all the choices that I've made
Every weakness, every failure, every time I've gone astray
Still your mercy stands before me, calling me to rise again
You don't count my past against me, you restore me in the end
I was lost but you were waiting
Grace was rising, never fading
Who is a God like you, pardoning all I've done?
You wash away my shame, through mercy I overcome
You don't stay in grief long, your love is always true
Who is a God like you?
You pass over my transgressions like they never were before
Not because I am deserving, but your mercy covers more
I'm the remnant of your promise held within your faithful hand
Even when I walk through darkness, you restore and help me stand
You delight in showing mercy
Grace rewrites my story
Who is a God like you?
Pardoning all I've done
You wash away my shame
Through mercy I overcome
You don't stay angry no more
Your love is always true
Who is a God like you?
You cast my sins into the sea
Forever lost in eternity
No chain remains, I've been set free
Your mercy is enough for me
No wrath remains
No debt I owe
Your love has washed me white as snow
Ooh, is it God like you?
Pardoning all I've done
You wash away my shame
For mercy I overcome
You don't stay angry long
Your love is always true
Who is a God like you?
Who is like you, Lord above?
Full of mercy
Full of love
